data.title: Reuse a reliable Studio QA startup and evidence helper
data.body: Extend existing Studio QA helpers with explicit checkout/profile validation, Windows-safe root comparison, dependency preflight, bounded build/resize readiness, and per-attempt evidence directories. Record actual source state, resolution and owned-process cleanup. Use it in two recent UI harnesses. Demonstrate delayed startup/resize handling, wrong-root rejection, and preservation of failed-attempt evidence. Never retry watchdog faults as success or weaken cleanup. Evidence: LUX-P90/P94/P96/P100/P121 and P91 notes. No general runner or Story runtime redesign. Checklist: implement; independent review; demonstrate; land.
